name: Unknowns
description: The Insane Unknowns (formally the Almighty Insane Unknown Nation) are a Chicago street gang founded circa 1964 by a member known as Popeye in the Bucktown neighborhood. Originally called the Unknown Souls, they renamed themselves the Unknowns in 1967 and initially wore all black. Around 1973, a leader known as T.J. expanded the gang to Leavitt and Schiller in Wicker Park, where they became the Insane Unknowns and adopted black and white as their colors. A People Nation affiliate, the gang has historically been active across northwest and west side Chicago neighborhoods including Wicker Park, West Humboldt Park, and K-Town, and is predominantly Hispanic though their early membership was mixed Hispanic and white.
